overview: Teens adopt AI learning tools, showing modest daily use and early college planning features.
OpenAI launches GPT‑6 with Intelligent UI, adding interactive visuals and custom tools to chat responses.
Industry scrutiny grows as safety concerns and regulatory actions target AI products for youth.

top.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
top.summary: OpenAI reports teens using ChatGPT for learning, with 2.7 M extra learning messages and 1.2 M using visualizations; average daily use under 15 minutes and new College Planner soon to aid applications.

top.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
top.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT‑6 with Intelligent UI, enabling text, graphics, buttons, forms, and interactive elements generated on‑the‑fly to improve answer clarity and task‑specific tools.

top.title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
top.summary: Common Sense Media rates ChatGPT for Teens as an unacceptable risk, citing persistent engagement cues and inadequate crisis responses despite OpenAI’s safeguards and parental controls.

top.title: ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface
top.summary: TechCrunch details OpenAI’s Intelligent UI rollout, showing interactive diagrams, calculators, and maps in GPT‑6 responses, with user‑controlled visual density across subscription tiers.

top.title: Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge
top.summary: Hugging Face releases open‑weight d1‑3B and d1‑omni‑600M multimodal decision models, delivering sub‑50 ms edge inference and high accuracy across text, vision, and audio tasks.

top.title: ChatGPT is getting college planning tools
top.summary: OpenAI announces College Planner for ChatGPT for Teens, consolidating application deadlines, tasks, and financial‑aid steps; also adds multi‑photo PDF capture and flashcard generation on iOS.
